_help: Pictures for the advertisement boards on the end walls of shophouse rows (render.js: ADS).
ads: up to four are shown; with fewer they take turns; with none the boards are painted as shop boards.
image: a file under engine/ (for example "assets/ads/my-ad.png") or a web address (https://...) that allows being drawn (CORS).
fit: "cover" (fills the board, cuts off what overhangs) or "contain" (shows the whole picture on the background colour).
background: the colour behind a "contain" picture. enabled: false leaves an entry out without deleting it.
The board is 6 m wide by 2.6 m high; each picture is drawn into a 1024 x 512 place (2:1), so a picture near 2:1 fits best.
The list is read once when the game loads: reload the page after changing it.
